look_here_first: Find an OPEN flower and measure the entire slender perianth tube from its base to the expanded limb: about 7–17 cm long and only 1–2 mm wide. Compare A. obtusa, whose open perianth is much shorter (about 2.5–5.5 cm total). Confirm narrow wedge-based opposite leaves and the thin ridges of a mature anthocarp; closed self-pollinating flowers do not provide the same tube comparison.

project_inclusion.range_basis: Kew POWO treats the accepted species as Texas-native at state level. Project three-target-county proof was not assessed in settled 2026-10-07 review; do not assign PASS.

morphology_keys.habit: Perennial dry-country herb or small subshrub with branched ascending to trailing stems; flowering habit and solitary versus paired flowers vary.
morphology_keys.leaves: Mostly opposite unequal paired simple leaves, usually lanceolate to narrow triangular-lanceolate with cuneate or decurrent bases; margins may be wavy or crispate.
morphology_keys.open_flower: Single petaloid perianth (NOT a true corolla plus calyx); very long narrow tube 7–17 cm × 1–2 mm, spreading limb roughly 10–20 mm across.
morphology_keys.fruit: One-seeded oblong anthocarp commonly 6–10 mm, with five thin often translucent longitudinal ridges and shallow paired grooves; inspect mature fruits under magnification.
morphology_keys.reproduction: Open chasmogamous flowers and reduced closed cleistogamous flowers may coexist; lack of a large open trumpet is not species exclusion.

comparisons.key_distinctions: A. obtusa has an open perianth only about 2.5–5.5 cm overall, broader delta-shaped leaves with truncate/rounded bases, and mature anthocarps with rib/groove ends forming small knobs. Mirabilis has differing involucre and anthocarp arrangements; Boerhavia usually has much smaller clustered flowers; morning-glories have a true corolla and separate calyx and a different fruit.
comparisons.cautions: Anthocarp length overlaps with A. obtusa, and vegetative outline alone is variable. Measure an intact OPEN flower tube and use ripe fruit ridge morphology; flower color and apparent number of petals are unreliable.

diagnostic_image_needs: Entire open perianth tube from base to limb with centimeter ruler
Opposite unequal leaf pair with base and margin macro
Mature anthocarp ribs and grooves with scale
